{{recipe}}

This recipe is a great choice for a Meatless Monday that still lets you convince the kids that it's a Sloppy Joe! You can serve the finished product on whole-wheat hamburger buns.

== Ingredients ==
* 2 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|olive oil]]
* ½ [[Cookbook:onion|onion]], [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]]
* ½ green [[Cookbook:Bell Pepper|bell pepper]], chopped
* ⅓ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] shredded [[Cookbook:carrot|carrot]]
* 1 can of chili [[cookbook:beans|beans]], undrained
* 1 ½ cups cooked brown [[Cookbook:rice|rice]]
* ¼ cup hickory-smoked [[Cookbook:Barbecue Sauce|barbecue sauce]], or to your preference
* Hamburger buns

== Procedure ==
# Add olive oil to pan over medium-high heat.
# Add onions, bell pepper, and carrots and cook for 3–4 minutes
# Add rice, chili beans, and barbecue sauce and cook for approximately 10–15 minutes, stirring frequently to heat thoroughly.
# Serve on hamburger buns.

==See also==
* [[Cookbook:Sloppy Joes|Sloppy Joes]]
